Name: Granada Cathedral & Central Park
Description: Colonial-era cathedral and main plaza at the heart of Granada's historic district; good landmark and meeting point before departure.

Name: Puerto de Asese – Isletas boat docks
Description: Dock area at the end of Granada's tourist center where small boats depart for tours among the Isletas de Granada on Lake Nicaragua.

Name: Volcán Mombacho (summit area)
Description: Cloud-forest–covered stratovolcano south of Granada; prominent landmark on the skyline as you ride out along the lake.

Name: La Cruz town center & viewpoint
Description: Hilltop town overlooking Bahía Salinas with central park and views across the Pacific and toward Nicaragua.

Name: Playa Hermosa (Guanacaste)
Description: Wide light-sand beach north of Playas del Coco, known for calm water, low green hills, and Blue Flag environmental certification.

Name: Playas del Coco beachfront
Description: Main bay and promenade at Playas del Coco, a long-established beach town and hub for diving and fishing in the Gulf of Papagayo.

Name: Paseo de los Turistas waterfront
Description: Waterfront walkway along the outer shore of Puntarenas with food stalls, ice cream, and views across the Gulf of Nicoya.

Name: Tarcoles River Crocodile Bridge
Description: Highway bridge over the Río Grande de Tárcoles where large American crocodiles can often be seen from the pedestrian walkway.

Name: Carara National Park entrance area
Description: Entrance zone for Carara National Park, protecting transition forest between dry and humid Pacific zones; short rainforest trails and rich birdlife.

Name: Playa Hermosa (Central Pacific)
Description: Surf beach within the Playa Hermosa–Punta Mala Wildlife Refuge, important for nesting olive ridley sea turtles.

Name: Playa Esterillos
Description: Long gray-sand beach (Esterillos area) with mangroves and coastal forest, quieter alternative to more developed resort towns.

Name: Quepos town center
Description: Compact coastal town that serves as the gateway to Manuel Antonio; services, local eateries, and bus links up the hill.

Name: Marina Pez Vela
Description: Modern marina complex in Quepos with restaurants, shops, and a broad promenade overlooking fishing boats and yachts.

Name: Manuel Antonio National Park (entrance area)
Description: Entrance area for Manuel Antonio National Park, famous for its dense wildlife, short forest trails, and scenic beaches.

Name: Playa Espadilla Norte
Description: Long public beach just north of the park boundary; easy access from the road, good for swimming, surfing, and sunset without park entry.
